## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the ceramic mug, turn it, set it on the table, then hang it on the medium-sized rack.

Task description: The objects are the light-colored ceramic cup on the left side of the table and the medium-sized rack with an angled hanging rod on the right. The task involves rotating the cup and returning it to the table, then hanging it on the rack.

Success criteria: Hang the cup by its handle on the right rack, in the hanging region near the rack middle as viewed from above and clearly above table height. The right gripper must be open.

## Execution tips

- Consider grasping a section of the side wall near the rim, away from the handle, with one finger inside and one outside. Match the opening to the wall thickness and available clearance, leaving room for the handle to pass over the hanging bar.
- Before closing, confirm that the pads are on the inside and outside of the cup wall with enough contact area, rather than pressing only on the rim.
- When rotating the cup, consider using an open area above the table. If a regrasp is needed, first let the cup base rest on the table rather than releasing it unsupported in midair.
- Near the hanging bar, point its free end toward the cup handle hole and adjust the handle angle slightly to match the angled bar. Avoid pressing the bar tip against the outside of the handle or brushing the post with the cup body.
- Before release, lower the cup gently so the inside of its handle rests on the rod. Confirm the rod supports the cup, then open the gripper gradually to avoid leaving the handle balanced only on the rod tip where it could slip off.
